objects.text: 在立体几何里，把一个图形映射成另一个图形的概念具有重要的作用. 映射概念的意义，同在平面几何里所讲的相同.
objects.author_coverage: Mapping as a total single-valued correspondence; no unstated injectivity or onto.

objects.text: 作为映射的例子，我们来研究三角形$ABC$在平面$\alpha$上平行于直线$l$的射影（图57）. 在这个映射下，三角形$ABC$的每一个点$M$与平面$\alpha$的唯一的点$M_1$对应.
objects.author_coverage: Unique projector-plane intersection formula under n.d!=0, without perpendicularity; F57 inventory.

objects.text: 如果图形$\Phi$的每一个点$M$与图形$F$的唯一的点$M_1$对应，那么这样的对应叫做图形$\Phi$在图形$F$内的映射.同时，点$M_1$叫做点$M$的象.
objects.author_coverage: Distinguish domain, codomain, actual image, injectivity and surjectivity.
Caption binding, not mathematical proof.

objects.text: 在上面的例子中，$\Phi=\triangle ABC$，$F=\alpha$. 三角形$ABC$在平面$\alpha$上的射影是三角形$A_1B_1C_1$（假设，平面$ABC$与直线$l$不平行）.
objects.author_coverage: Rank-2 affine bijection under stated nonparallel condition, and separately rank-1 segment collapse; inclusive line-plane parallelism.

objects.text: 图形$\Phi$所有的点的象组成的集合$\Phi_1$，叫做图形$\Phi$的象.从映射的定义得到$\Phi_1\subset F$. 如果$\Phi_1=F$，那么说：图形$\Phi$被映射成图形$\Phi_1$. 例如，当平行于直线$l$向平面$\alpha$上投影时，四面体$ABCD$的象是四边形$A_1B_1C_1D_1$（图58）. 因此也说，四面体$ABCD$被映射成四边形$A_1B_1C_1D_1$.
objects.author_coverage: Inclusive subset use, affine convex hull, tetrahedron triangle/quadrilateral alternatives, and separation of solid/surface/frame.

objects.text: 研究的两个映射的例子，本质上是不同的. 其中第一个例子里，三角形$ABC$的任何两个不同的点的象是不同的. 第二个映射的特征是，四面体$ABCD$的不同的点$M$和$M'$有相同的象（图58）.
objects.author_coverage: Kernel proof of injective planar restriction; distinct interior fibre points or boundary fibre endpoints prove tetrahedron noninjectivity.
objects.optical_limit: This prose does not resolve which F58 source M-token is M or M-prime.

objects.author_coverage: Caption bound to a particular drawing, not a universal four-sided image theorem.
Caption only; no metric measurement inferred from pixels.

objects.text: 再举一个例子.
objects.author_coverage: Narrative transition, no new condition.

objects.text: 如果点$O$是线段$MM_1$中点（图59），点$M$和$M_1$叫做关于中心$O$对称. 中心$O$被认为是和自己对称.
objects.author_coverage: Unique formula 2o-x, opposite-ray construction when x!=o, separate centre case x=o.

objects.text: 使空间的每一个点$M$和它关于已知中心$O$的对称点$M_1$相对应，得到空间到它自身的映射. 这种映射叫做中心对称. 两个不同的点在中心对称下被映射成不同的点.
objects.author_coverage: Independent injectivity, surjectivity, involution, distance and affine-incidence preservation.

objects.text: 定义. 在空间到它自身的映射下，如果任意两个不同的点有不同的象，这种映射叫做空间的变换.
objects.author_coverage: No explicit onto condition; disclose global-inverse gap with an injective nononto example.

objects.text: 中心对称是空间变换的一种. 以$O$为中心的中心对称将用符号$Z_0$表示.
objects.author_coverage: Centre symmetry satisfies the literal definition; author Z_O notation is separately declared and does not correct the source.

objects.text: 其它一些空间变换将在以后研究.
objects.author_coverage: Future treatment is deferred; no future lesson used.

objects.text: 任一空间变换可以用字母$f$表示. 如果$f$将点$M$映射成点$M_1$，那么记作$f(M)=M_1$. 记法$f(\Phi)=\Phi_1$表示将图形$\Phi$映射成图形$\Phi_1$.
objects.author_coverage: Point-value and set-image notation, not an assertion that every stated codomain is filled.

objects.text: 变换$f$可以看作是所有有序点对$(M, M_1)$的集合，其中$M_1=f(M)$. 所有有序点对$(M_1, M)$同时还确定另外一个变换，即把$M_1$映射成$M$的变换. 这样的变换叫做$f$的逆变换，记作$f^{-1}$. 如果$f(M)=M_1$，那么$f^{-1}(M_1)=M$.
objects.author_coverage: Unique inverse on f(S); full-space inverse needs onto. Both cancellation domains explicitly distinguished.

objects.text: 依次实行变换$f_1$和$f_2$，结果得到一个新的变换：$f(M)=f_2(f_1(M))$. 如果$f_1(M)=M_1$和$f_2(M_1)=M_2$，那么$f(M)=M_2$. 变换$f$叫做变换$f_1$和$f_2$的合成变换.
objects.author_coverage: First f1 then f2, totality and injectivity proof, shape-image composition, associative evaluation and typed inverse order.

objects.text: 变换$f_1$和$f_2$的合成变换$f$记作：$f_2\circ f_1=f$.
objects.author_coverage: Preserve right-to-left application order.

objects.text: 把空间的每一个点映射成这点本身的空间变换叫做恒等变换，用字母$E$表示. 根据定义，对于空间的任何点$M$有：$E(M)=M$. 变换$E$可以看作是所有的重合的点对的集合.
objects.author_coverage: Diagonal graph, two-sided identity, centre-symmetry square, inverse cancellation and image-domain distinction.

author_cases: Triangle: rank 2 triangle, rank 1 nonzero segment; side collapse and three distinct collinear vertex images; no point.
Trapezoid: rank 2 same trapezoid convention, rank 1 nonzero segment with 2/3/4 distinct vertex values; base ratio only when noncollapsed.
Tetrahedron solid/surface: convex quadrilateral or triangle, including interior/edge/coincident fourth projection; full lifting existence proof; no rank collapse below 2.
Parallelepiped solid/surface: parallelogram or centrally symmetric convex hexagon; zero/parallel/distinct projected generator cases and support-edge proof.
Tetrahedron and parallelepiped edge frames: exact projected edge unions, not filled silhouettes.
No forced generic position, cube, perpendicular projection or strict parallelism.
No transformation: x and x+t*d collide for t!=0; onto alpha does not imply injectivity.
A fixed by the explicit centre case.
B_1,C_1,D_1 uniquely constructed on opposite rays with matching distances.
Midpoint correctness, existence and uniqueness, distinct/noncoplanar image vertices and image tetrahedron.
Only O is a fixed point.
A line is setwise invariant iff it contains O; external-centre case gives a distinct parallel line.
A plane is setwise invariant iff it contains O; external-centre case gives a distinct parallel plane.
Necessity and sufficiency, existence, setwise versus pointwise invariance, inclusive coincidence, and paired-point criterion for all invariant sets.
Inverse equals itself with global surjectivity independently proved.
Same-centre composition equals E, including the centre point.
E circle f=f by pointwise evaluation.
Image-domain inverse after f gives E_S without onto.
If inverse is required to be a global space transformation, missing onto is disclosed; a global inverse need not exist under the literal definition.
Opposite cancellation gives identity on f(S), not automatically all S; injective nononto counterexample provided.

prior_prose_definition_sources.text: 在立体几何中，平行直线的定义仍保留平面几何中的定义：如果两条直线在同一个平面内，且没有公共点或重合，就说这两条直线平行（图 9，а 和 б）.
prior_prose_definition_sources.needed_for: Coincident lines remain parallel; no strict-only parallelism.

prior_prose_definition_sources.text: 定义. 如果直线和平面没有公共点或直线在平面内，就说直线和平面平行.
prior_prose_definition_sources.needed_for: B06 nonparallel-plane condition and rank collapse include contained direction lines.

prior_prose_definition_sources.text: 定义. 如果两个平面没有公共点或者重合，就说这两个平面平行.
prior_prose_definition_sources.needed_for: Coincident invariant planes remain parallel under original terminology.

prior_prose_definition_sources.text: 假定已知平面 $\alpha$ 和与 $\alpha$ 相交的直线 $l$（图 39）. 取任意一点 $A_1$；通过它作直线 $l_1$ 与直线 $l$ 平行. 直线 $l_1$ 交 $\alpha$ 于某个点 $A$（图 39）. 用这样的方法得到的点 $A$，叫做平行于直线 $l$投影时，点 $A_1$ 在平面 $\alpha$ 上的射影（简单地说，点 $A$ 是点 $A_1$ 的平行射影）. 已知图形 $\phi_1$ 的所有点的平行投影的集合 $\phi$，叫做图形 $\phi_1$ 的平行射影.
prior_prose_definition_sources.needed_for: Transverse projection direction and point-set image; perpendicularity not given.

prior_prose_definition_sources.text: 正六边形 $A_1B_1C_1D_1E_1F_1$（图 41）的模型投在墙上的影子成多边形 $ABCDEF$ 的形状. 观察这个影子（当六边形的平面相对于墙的平面取各种不同的位置时），可以设想关于平行投影的几个性质. 在叙述这些性质时，假设是平行于直线 $l$ 进行投影的，而且直线 $l$ 与被投影的直线或线段不平行.
prior_prose_definition_sources.needed_for: Do not apply noncollapsed line/segment projection properties to direction-parallel collapsed cases.

prior_prose_definition_sources.text: 最简单的多面体是三棱锥（图12）.它一共有四个面.因此，我们将它简称为四面体.如果多面体和平面的交集是多边形，那么这个多边形叫做已知平面截多面体的截面.
prior_prose_definition_sources.needed_for: Tetrahedron identity as the triangular-pyramid polyhedron, not a prescribed cubic model.

prior_prose_definition_sources.text: * “多面体”，“圆柱”，“平行六面体”等等将在十年级定义.现在我们以八年级所学的知识为根据.
prior_prose_definition_sources.needed_for: Disclose the solid/surface/frame representation boundary rather than claiming the earlier prose settles every set convention.

prior_prose_definition_sources.text: 在平面 $\alpha$ 内作平行四边形 $ABCD$（图 27）. 过它的所有顶点作不在平面 $\alpha$ 内的平行线. 线段 $AA_1$、$BB_1$、$CC_1$、$DD_1$ 都相等，且全在平面 $\alpha$ 的同一侧.
prior_prose_definition_sources.needed_for: Independent transverse edge direction and affine parallelepiped interval-sum model.

prior_prose_definition_sources.text: 这四条线段的端点是多面体的顶点，所有的六个面都是平行四边形. 这样的多面体叫做平行六面体.
prior_prose_definition_sources.needed_for: Six parallelogram faces, without imposing rectangularity or a cube.
